value.description:
Van Rijswijk Tweewielers, Al 109 jaar de fietsenmaker van Tilburg.

Sinds 2015 mag Van Rijswijk Tweewielers zich bij Koninklijke Beschikking Hofleverancier noemen wegens het lange bestaan.

Dé plaats voor nieuwe fietsen, elektrische fietsen, occasions, reparatie en deskundig advies.

Wij dealer van de volgende merken:

Fietsen, elektrische fietsen en bakfietsen:

- Trek
- Advanced Ebike Das Original
- Cortina
- Urban Arrow
- Van Raam aangepaste fietsen

Verder heeft Van Rijswijk Tweewielers een breed assortiment accessoires en onderdelen op voorraad voor fietsen, bromfietsen, oldtimers en scooters.

In onze ruim uitgeruste werkplaats repareren wij alle merken fietsen, elektrische fietsen en bakfietsen.

Als uw tweewieler schade heeft kunnen wij hiervan een schade expertise maken wat geaccepteerd wordt door alle verzekerings maatschapijen.

Als uw tweewieler defect is en u kunt hem zelf niet na onze werkplaats brengen voor reparatie hebben wij ook een ophaal service, Neem hiervoor contact op met ons om een afspraak te maken.

U kunt bij ons ook een verzekering afsluiten voor uw tweewieler, Wij zijn een volmachtbedrijf van ANWB, Enra en Kingpolis verzekeringen.

Heeft u nog vragen neem dan contact met ons op of kom langs in onze winkel. De koffie staat altijd klaar !

Openingstijden:

Maandag: gesloten
Dinsdag: 09.00 - 18.00
Woensdag: 09.00 - 18.00
Donderdag: 09.00 - 20.00
Vrijdag: 09.00 - 18.00
Zaterdag: 10.30 - 16.30
Zondag: gesloten

Tot ziens bij Van Rijswijk Tweewielers sinds 1913 uw fietsenmaker.

Zoekwoorden:fiets  fietsenmaker tilburg gazelle batavus sparta merida pepper cube

200.description:
Read one Marktplaats listing by id or URL: title, full description, price and price type, public bids (amount and time, no bidder names), condition, brand and the other listed attributes, images, category, city, listing date, view and favorite counts, shipping method and Marktplaats shipping options with prices, and the seller's public profile (name, private or business, time on Marktplaats, review rating and count, verification badges). Seller contact details are never returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attributes` | object[] | Kenmerken as shown: condition, brand and the category's own fields. |
| `bids` | object |  |
| `brand` | string | Merk attribute, or the page's structured brand. |
| `buy_it_now` | boolean | Direct Kopen (pay and ship through Marktplaats) is enabled. |
| `category` | object |  |
| `condition` | string | Conditie attribute, e.g. Gebruikt. |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `description` | string | Full description text with line breaks. |
| `favorite_count` | number |  |
| `images` | string[] |  |
| `listing_id` | string |  |
| `location` | object |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `posted_at` | string | When the listing went live (Marktplaats' 'since'). |
| `price` | number | EUR. The asking price, the minimum bid for min_bid, 0 for free, null when no amount is shown. |
| `price_type` | string | Normalized price type: fixed (vaste prijs), min_bid (bieden vanaf, price is the minimum bid), bidding (bieden, no start price), free (gratis, price 0), on_request (op aanvraag), see_description (zie omschrijving), exchange (ruilen), negotiable (n.o.t.k.), reserved, other (an unrecognised type; see price_type_raw). |
| `price_type_raw` | string |  |
| `reserved` | boolean |  |
| `seller` | object | Public seller profile. Contact details (phone, e-mail, address) are never returned. |
| `shipping` | object |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string |  |
| `view_count` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Finding second-hand or new items for sale in the Netherlands: call with a query, then narrow with category_id/subcategory_id from categories, filters from filters, min_price/max_price, postcode/distance_km, condition or sort. Take listing_id into listing for the full description, bids and seller profile.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

category_id.description:
Top-level category id from a previous result's categories (an entry with parent_id null), e.g. 445 Fietsen en Brommers.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 99999999.

condition.description: Item condition (Nieuw, Zo goed als nieuw, Gebruikt, Refurbished, Niet werkend); several values match any of them. Same as filters {"condition": [...]}.

distance_km.description:
Only listings within this many km of postcode; needs postcode.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 300.

filters.description: Chosen filters as key/value pairs: keys are a returned filter's key, values one of its values[].value (or an array of them for multi_select filters). Example: {"delivery": "Verzenden", "offeredSince": "Een week", "storage": ["128 GB", "256 GB"]}. A key or value the search does not offer is rejected as invalid_input.

max_price.description:
Highest price in EUR.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000000.

min_price.description:
Lowest price in EUR.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000000.

page.description:
Result page, 30 listings per page; pass next_page from the previous result. The site serves at most max_page pages.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 1.

postcode.description: Dutch postcode, e.g. '1012 AB'. Results then carry their distance from it. Pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3} ?[A-Za-z]{2}$.

query.description: Search keywords as typed in the Marktplaats search box, e.g. 'fiets' or 'iphone 15'. Optional when category_id is given.

sort.description:
Result order from the site's sort menu: relevance (default), newest or oldest listing date, price low to high, price high to low.

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "newest", "oldest", "price_asc", "price_desc"].

subcategory_id.description:
Subcategory id from categories (an entry whose parent_id is category_id); needs category_id.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 99999999.

200.description:
Search Marktplaats listings by keyword and/or category and return one page of up to 30: listing id, title, snippet, price in EUR with its type (fixed, bidding, minimum bid, free, op aanvraag, ...), city and distance from a postcode, listing date, seller name and type when shown, whether shipping is offered, condition, thumbnail, category and URL. Also returns the category facet and the filters the search offers (condition, delivery, listing age and category-specific fields) so a follow-up call can pass chosen values back in filters. Price range, postcode plus radius, sort and condition are separate inputs.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `categories` | object[] | Category facet: top-level categories (parent_id null) and subcategories with their number of matching listings. Pass ids back as category_id / subcategory_id. |
| `category_id` | number |  |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `filters` | object[] | Filters this search offers (condition, delivery, offeredSince, and category-specific ones such as brand, storage or color in a category). Pass key and values[].value back in the filters input. |
| `has_more` | boolean |  |
| `max_page` | number | Last page the site serves for this search. |
| `next_page` | number | Pass as page for the next page; null on the last page. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `subcategory_id` | number |  |
| `suggested_query` | string | Spelling suggestion when the site offers one. |
| `total_count` | number |  |
| `url` | string | The search API request that answered. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
